title: Christmas Unicorn Bold & Easy Coloring Book for Kids
subtitle: 50 Big, Simple Holiday Unicorn Pictures for Toddlers & Kids Ages 3-6
cover_tagline: Bold lines, big fun, merry unicorns!
back_text: Meet 50 friendly Christmas unicorns and their festive friends! Every page has one big, simple picture with thick bold lines, perfect for little hands learning to colour.

From unicorns in Santa hats to sleigh rides, gingerbread, snowmen and hot cocoa, there is something to colour on every page. Each picture sits on its own page with a blank back, so markers won't bleed through.
A sweet, screen-free gift for Christmas morning, stocking stuffers or long holiday afternoons.

description_html:
Big, bold, friendly Christmas unicorns for little hands to colour!

  • 50 pictures, each on its own page with a blank back (no marker bleed-through)
  • Thick bold lines and big simple shapes, perfect for ages 3-6
  • Unicorns in Santa hats, pulling a sleigh and decorating the tree, plus gingerbread, snowmen, presents, stockings and hot cocoa
  • One big, easy subject per page, with no tiny details to frustrate beginners
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch pages

A magical stocking stuffer or Christmas gift for any little unicorn lover.
cover_prompt: A bright, cheerful Christmas scene for kids: a smiling cute unicorn in a red Santa hat and striped scarf with a rainbow mane, standing beside a decorated Christmas tree with a gold star, a smiling gingerbread man, a happy snowman with a carrot nose, a stack of wrapped presents with big bows, and candy canes, soft falling snow and rounded snowy hills.
aplus_caption: Bold, easy pages for little Christmas unicorn fans
